title: Playboy Magazine December 1994 Bo Derek Gala Christmas Garry Shandling
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1994 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $5.95.

Features:
- Bo Derek: "Bo, A Perfect 40" - cover and pictorial
- Playboy Interviews Garry Shandling
- Roger Ebert on Tom Hanks
- Vincent Bugliosi on lawyers, judges and O.J.'s bloody hands
- John Bobbitt's ex-fiancee
- Plus Jim Carrey, Kelsey Grammer, Buck Henry, Sex Stars of 1994
